title: Why Half Your Brain Refuses Deep Sleep on Hotel Night One?
topic: Why Your Left Hemisphere Stays Awake on Your First Night in a Hotel Bed
act5_climax_episode: In 2016 at Brown University, Masako Tamaki and Yuka Sasaki played soft oddball tones into sleeping volunteers' ears and discovered that right-ear tones routed to the vigilant left hemisphere woke sleepers three times faster on Night 1 than on Night 2.
